## LoggingUtil class

Extends [LoggingPretty](https://www.npmjs.com/package/logging-pretty) to provide enhanced logging functionality.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare class LoggingUtil extends LoggingPretty 
```
**Extends:** LoggingPretty

## Remarks

Inherits all methods from `LoggingPretty` including `info()`<!-- -->, `debug()`<!-- -->, `warn()`<!-- -->, `error()`<!-- -->, and `success()`<!-- -->. Adds helper methods for formatted error logging with class/function context.

## Example


```typescript
import { LoggingUtil, log } from "gramstax";

// Use the singleton
log.info("Application started");

// Or create a new instance
const logger = new LoggingUtil();
logger.errorMake(new Error("Oops"), "Worker", "init");
```
